pieces.text: With so little information to go on, and the problems mounting further, (leader) must make a decision quickly for the sake of the village. But, who should (leader) go to for advice?

Time which grows ever shorter." Chief (leader) thanks the spiritual leaders for their wise counsel and makes (leader.his/her) decree.
